## Sign-off

Every commit carries a `Signed-off-by:` line (`git commit -s` adds it), saying you have the right to contribute it under the Developer Certificate of Origin. CONTRIBUTING.md says more. To add it to commits you've already made: `git rebase --signoff main`, then push again.
